title: HelperFSWriteOpenResult
description: Result of the helper fs service's write-open op: where the write will actually land. Every symlink on the requested path was resolved exactly once, at open time, so a caller writing through a link reports the file rather than the link — and a commit naming the link installs at this resolved path, leaving the link intact.

resolved.description: The absolute path the bytes will be installed at. It is the provider-canonical spelling of the target, never the lexical one the caller sent.
